name: Banarasi Saree
story: Handwoven in Varanasi since Mughal era, known for fine silk and zari work.
authentication: Check the weaving density – genuine Banarasi has 400+ threads per inch.

name: Bagh Print
story: Traditional hand-block printing from Bagh, Madhya Pradesh, using natural dyes.
authentication: Look for small irregularities in the print – machine prints are too perfect.

name: Kanchipuram Silk
story: Temple-inspired motifs, heavy silk saree from Tamil Nadu.
authentication: Real Kanchipuram has a distinct 'thud' sound when stretched – ask for the sound test.

name: Pochampally Ikat
story: Double-ikat weave from Telangana, known for geometric patterns.
authentication: Check the back side – genuine ikat has the same pattern on both sides.

name: Darjeeling Tea
story: World-famous muscatel flavour, grown in Himalayan foothills.
authentication: Genuine Darjeeling has a 'Darjeeling' logo and a unique floral aroma.
